services.name: Neighbors' Day - Adventure Park & Ropes Course with Round-Trip Catamaran Cruise
services.desc: Embark on an adventure for the whole family! These self-guided courses range in difficulty level from very easy to challenging and are comprised of various treetop obstacles and ziplines. Upon arrival, you are equipped with a harness and gloves. All harnesses are double sling-style with a carabineer and pulley providing a continuous belay system that allows you to advance through the obstacles at your own pace. This tour is available with a round-trip catamaran cruise between Juneau and Icy Strait Point, or as a stand-alone option if you would like to play again. Highlights: Round-trip
